headline: Bhooth Bangla Closes ₹89 Cr Week 1. D2 Crosses ₹1,121 Cr. Vaazha 2 Past ₹213 Cr WW.
subline: BB W1 close ₹89 Cr India / ₹137 Cr WW (Taran + BH consensus, BCM 91%) · D2 W6 begins at ₹1,121 Cr India / ₹1,764 Cr WW · UK overtaken Pathaan as biggest Indian grosser · Vaazha 2 lifetime ₹113 Cr India / ₹213 Cr WW · 5th Malayalam film in 200 Cr club · Total chart take ~₹133 Cr

scoreboard.note: D0 ₹3.75 · D1 ₹12.25 · D2 ₹19 · D3 ₹23 · D4 ₹6.75 · D5 ₹8 · D6 ₹6.80 · D7 ~₹5.50 BCM. Taran Adarsh + BH: ₹89.45 Cr 6-day · ₹105.86 Cr gross · $3.40M overseas. WW ₹137 Cr. Studio: Balaji Motion Pictures + Cape of Good Films.
W5 close ₹16.5 Cr · W6 begins D36. Sacnilk-confirmed lifetime ₹1,121.09 Cr India / ₹1,764.15 Cr WW. UK overtaken Pathaan (£4.39M). 18M+ BMS tickets — 2nd film ever. ₹24 Cr from Baahubali 2.

scoreboard.film: Vaazha 2: Biopic of a Billion Bros
scoreboard.note: W3 ₹14.5 Cr · D22 lifetime ₹112.55 Cr India net / ₹130 Cr gross / ₹213 Cr WW. 5th Malayalam film over ₹200 Cr WW · 7th over ₹100 Cr India nett · Fastest Kerala 100 Cr (16 days).

interval_take: Three structural calls this week. First: Bhooth Bangla's ₹89 Cr W1 close locks the HIT verdict — Akshay Kumar's third-best post-pandemic opening behind only Sooryavanshi and Housefull 5. The Sacnilk-vs-Taran/BH ₹10.5 Cr gap is BCM's textbook Hindi inflation pattern (~13% over-attribution on Sacnilk Hindi numbers). Going with Taran + BH consensus on this one. Second: D2 enters W6 having crossed ₹1,121 Cr India and ₹1,764 Cr WW — only ₹24 Cr from Baahubali 2's ₹1,788 Cr lifetime WW record. Pathaan UK overtake on Apr 22 is the milestone of the week. Third: Vaazha 2 is now a ₹213 Cr WW film against a sub-₹15 Cr budget — likely the highest-ROI Malayalam release of the year, full stop. Trade press has been under-counting it; Boxoffy correction is in the chart.
nextWeek: Week 18 (Apr 24-30) opens with Hollywood biggie Michael (paid previews tonight, full release Apr 24) — first wide Hollywood India release in 4 weeks. BB show count already cut 50% to make room. BB W2 tracking ₹35-42 Cr at 80% conf. D2 W6 ~₹6 Cr expected. South: Vishwambhara (Chiranjeevi) advance booking suggests ₹15-18 Cr Day 1 BCM.

headline: D2 Crosses ₹920 Cr on D14. Bhooth Bangla Blinks. ₹1,000 Cr India This Week.
subline: D14 ₹20.10 Cr (Wed Apr 1) confirmed by Sacnilk. D0–D14 ₹920.02 Cr India nett. Bhooth Bangla moved to Apr 17 giving D2 a clear W3 window. ₹1,000 Cr India nett — first ever for a Hindi film — is the conversation this week. Super Mario Galaxy opens globally. IPL underway.

scoreboard.note: D14 ₹20.10 Cr ✅ (Sacnilk) · D0–D14 ₹920.02 Cr · WW ~₹1,466 Cr · D15 Hanuman Jayanti est ₹10 Cr · Bhooth Bangla cleared field → clean W3
W2 India ~₹4.5 Cr est · US $164.3M cume · WW $300M+ · Super Mario Galaxy opens this weekend — PHM shifts to #2

interval_take: ₹920 Cr in 14 days. Bhooth Bangla — which had already moved once — moved again, citing D2's run. That is the truest indicator of a cultural phenomenon. When competing films rearrange their own release calendars around you, the box office has spoken. ₹1,000 Cr India nett would be the first time a Hindi film has crossed that number. Baahubali 2 did it, Pushpa 2 did it — both Telugu. Dhurandhar 2 is two weekends away from making history in Hindi cinema's own language.
nextWeek: Bhooth Bangla (Apr 17, Akshay Kumar + Priyadarshan) · Dacoit (Apr 10, Adivi Sesh) · Super Mario Galaxy Movie now in India · D2 eyes ₹1,000 Cr India nett

interval_take: D12 Monday came in at ₹25.30 Cr — a natural dip as IPL 2026 began and the second weekday cycle settled. D0–D12 India nett stands at ₹867 Cr on BOI basis (Sacnilk calculates ₹872 Cr using D5 ₹65 Cr — Boxoffy takes BOI's ₹60 Cr). KGF Chapter 2's India lifetime (₹859.7 Cr nett) has been passed. ₹1,000 Cr nett is the next milestone — at D8-D12 averaging ₹49.5 Cr/day, the film needs 3–4 more strong days. WW stands at ~₹1,392 Cr. NA has already broken Baahubali 2's all-time Indian film record at $23M+. D2 is now the #2 Hindi film of all time in India nett behind Pathaan (₹543 Cr? No) — actually #1 Hindi film of all time.
nextWeek: D13 Tue + D14 Wed key — ₹1,000 Cr India nett target by Thu Apr 2. IPL headwind manageable on weekdays. D2 eyes Pathaan overseas record. No new major Hindi competition until mid-April.

sources.take: $81M 5-day global for D2 — 2nd biggest Indian opening ever. $14M NA 5-day at 987 sites — all-time Bollywood NA record.

interval_take: Boxoffy correction issued. After cross-referencing BOI and Pinkvilla against Sacnilk, Sacnilk Hindi figures appear inflated — particularly D1 where Sacnilk reports ₹99.1 Cr vs BOI ₹75 Cr and Pinkvilla ₹73 Cr, a 33% gap. Pinkvilla and BOI align closely throughout. Revised canonical: BOI Hindi D0-D7 ₹532 Cr + other languages ~₹30 Cr = ~₹562 Cr India nett. WW ₹1,006.50 Cr is not disputed — Sacnilk WW uses confirmed distributor data. BLOCKBUSTER verdict and all records unchanged — D2 is still historic at any number.

boxoffy_note: Data note: India nett figures for D2 vary across tracking sites. BOI and Pinkvilla align at ~₹532 Cr Hindi + ~₹30 Cr other languages = ~₹562 Cr. Other trackers report higher figures using different methodologies. Boxoffy adopts the BOI/Pinkvilla consensus as canonical. WW ₹1,006.50 Cr is consistent across all sources.
